newsitem.title: UK: Rank eyes Tom Cobleigh buy - paper.
newsitem.headline: Rank eyes Tom Cobleigh buy - paper.

text.p: The Rank Organisation Plc is in line to buy the Tom Cobleigh pub chain after a possible deal with Yates Brothers Wine Lodges was called off, the Sunday Telegraph newspaper reported.
A spokesman for Rank declined to comment on the report while there was no one immediately available at either Tom Cobleigh or Yates.
The Sunday Telegraph said Yates and Tom Cobleigh had been ready to announce a 100 million stg takeover last week but that it was ditched for a higher offer.
But it said no details of such a better offer or of the bidder had emerged. Tom Cobleigh said on September 13 that it was in talks which might lead to an offer for the company.
It is a pub retailer which operates in Yorkshire, north east England, and the Midlands.

In August, Tom Cobleigh said it was cooperating with Earlier European Acquisition Capital Ltd (EAC) in examining options for disposing of EAC's 50 percent stake in the company. -- London Newsroom +44 171 5427717
